test_title: PYST 16: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Five persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). B is sitting second to the right of D. A is sitting second to the right of B. C is not an immediate neighbour of A. Who is sitting on the immediate right of D?
solution: **Given:** Five persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. 1) B is sitting second to the right of D. 2) A is sitting second to the right of B.
